summary:
Frontend-only Expo/React Native TTRPG app retested on mobile viewport (390x844) via preview URL. Verified all bug fixes and new features: (1) HP max is fixed at 20 (no hp-max-input); +/- work and hearts remain tappable with tap-to-set-HP behavior. (2) Tapping stat NAME (stat-main-STR, sub-skill-STR-N) triggers the dice modal with correct verdict; tapping the stat NUMBER (stat-main-value-STR / sub-skill-value-*) only edits the value and does NOT open a modal. Values persist. (3) STRENGTH/DEXTERITY/INTELLIGENCE/CHARISMA labels render fully readable (verified via textContent). (4) Dice modal shows verdict text and Close works. (5) Structured abilities: Once Per Turn add/edit/link-stat/effect-type cycle/effect-roll/use/delete all work. StatPickerModal opens, row 1 selects STRENGTH and chip shows 'STRENGTH ≥15'. Using an ability rolls d20 vs target; on SUCCESS the effect-total (from 1d6+2) is displayed. Delete removes the card. (6) Custom sections: add-custom-section creates section with editable title/content; both persist through page reload; delete removes it. (7) Character sheet reload restores name/class/hp/stat values from AsyncStorage.

ONE BUG FOUND during code review: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 123 references item.hpMax which no longer exists on the Character type — will render as broken 'X / undefined' on the character list HP row. Should use the HP_MAX constant or the fixed literal 20.

ui_bugs.issue: Row HP text uses {item.hp} / {item.hpMax} but Character has no hpMax field anymore (HP_MAX is a module constant). Renders 'X / undefined' on web / breaks Text child. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:123

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 123: replace {item.hpMax} with {HP_MAX} (import from '@/src/types') or hardcode /20.
critical_code_review_comments: character/[id].tsx is ~700 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting AbilitySection and header into their own files.

HpTracker.tapHeart depletes when tapping a filled heart to that index (HP=idx). If the user intent is 'tap heart-5 -> HP=5 filled up to that heart', the current behavior matches that spec; ensure UX explanation to user matches.
DiceRollModal only rolls the effect on success/crit-success (correct per spec); if the linkedStat is undefined but effect exists, it falls through to effect-only flow correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test characters via UI to exercise flows; storage cleared between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://campaign-companion-13.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. AsyncStorage key aob:characters:v1. All new testIDs work: hp-heart-N, hp-plus, hp-minus, stat-main-<KEY>, stat-main-value-<KEY>, sub-skill-<KEY>-N, sub-skill-value-<KEY>-N, add-oncePerTurn/oncePerRest/heroAbilities, ability-<key>-<idx>-{title,description,link-stat,effect-type,effect-roll,use,delete}, stat-picker-close, stat-picker-row-N, add-custom-section, custom-section-<id>-{title,content,delete}, dice-verdict-text, dice-roll-close, effect-total.
rca_of_issue: index.tsx was not updated when hpMax was removed from the Character type in favor of the HP_MAX constant. TypeScript strict mode would have caught this; consider enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess and strict property checks.
